input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 8(d) grants TrueLink a worldwide licence to distribute, disseminate, license, resell and exploit Credit Data (our borrowers' and applicants' data supplied through the Interface) — independent exploitation of Client data well beyond processing it to deliver the services, which fails the fallback (and preferred) data element. Nothing elsewhere cures this: section 10 only imposes confidentiality, and section 2(d) merely preserves TrueLink's ownership of the Interface. The Agreement also gives Client no licence at all to the results of the Hosting and Support Services, so the fallback deliverables licence (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, with modify and sublicense rights) is absent. We therefore target the fallback: TrueLink keeps ownership of its Interface, tools and know-how, Client obtains the fallback deliverables licence, and the Credit Data licence is limited to processing to provide the services (the existing Non-Competition Agreement limitation is retained).

mappings.element: Vendor may retain ownership of generic tools and know-how.
mappings.quote: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.

mappings.element: Customer's licence to Deliverables is perpetual.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is irrevocable.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is worldwide.
Customer's licence to Deliverables is royalty-free.
Customer may use and modify Deliverables for its business.
Customer may sublicense Deliverables for its business.
Any Vendor licence in Customer Data is limited to processing it solely to provide the Services.

proposal.summary: Add a perpetual deliverables licence to Client and narrow TrueLink's Credit Data licence to processing to provide the services
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 8(d) currently lets TrueLink distribute, resell and exploit our borrower Credit Data, so we have limited that licence to processing the data to provide the services, and we have added the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables that our playbook requires as its fallback position.

ops.text: Deliverables. TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense for its business all deliverables and work product prepared for Client under this Agreement, including the results of the Support Services.

ops.oldText: to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data
ops.newText: to use, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data solely to process it to provide the services under this Agreement
